title: Layouts, pages and templates: Layouts preserve shared UI and local state between sibling navigations; templates create a fresh instance when a matching segment changes
description: Next.js 16 and TypeScript 5 App Router lesson for layouts, pages and templates. Includes an intentionally broken starter, a corrected contract, verified-path offline tests and official documentation.
objectives: Layouts preserve shared UI and local state between sibling navigations; templates create a fresh instance when a matching segment changes.
Repair the intentionally failing next-layout-template model.
Explain which behaviors need real Next.js compilation or browser integration verification.
rubric: I can explain layouts, pages and templates in Next.js 16 without mixing older Pages Router semantics.
I can reproduce and fix the 07.01.02 failing starter with real data inputs.
I can identify the missing Next.js build, routing and HTTP integration evidence.
